acceptance_signals: The task binds resolved alignment journey mcpj-1fd2da6fc67e4fd28e356ccc5bef7587 and the human-selected child-identity diagnostic direction without treating alignment as task admission.

Read-only preflight confirms the retained runtime, remote-free clone, original consumer, Starter worktree, user Codex configuration, Codex executable, and pre-existing process identities before any launch.

The diagnostic uses only transient read-only Windows process observation; it does not edit the project command, create a launcher wrapper, enable persistent tracing, change user configuration, or read session content or broad host logs.

Observed process evidence is normalized to parent relationship, process basename, executable classification and digest, and an allow-list of environment-state classifications; raw command lines, complete PATH values, usernames, process identifiers, absolute paths, and unrelated process data are not retained.
At most one separately approved user-host Codex App Server startup is attempted with the retained runtime first on process-local PATH, the admitted clone binding, and no persistent trust change.
The startup sends only initialize, initialized, and one thread/start; it stops before turn/start, prompt submission, model interaction, tool invocation, retry, repair, or second launch.

If the MCP child exits too quickly or Windows cannot expose an allow-listed fact, the evidence records the smallest unknown and stops without widening observation, reading logs, changing the launcher, or retrying.
The result distinguishes whether the failed child resolves to the retained launcher, the older global launcher, or another identity as far as deterministic evidence permits.

User configuration, original and retained AIRBNB repositories, retained runtime, Starter source, credentials, Git state, remotes, and external systems remain unchanged; unavoidable user-home metadata effects are reported without cleanup.
The task and repository checks, cumulative scope reconciliation, task JSON parsing, bounded privacy scans, baseline suite, and git diff check pass or truthfully report preserved excluded state.
The task stops before launcher pinning, repair, dependency download, cleanup, commit, push, publication, release, deployment, or broader activation.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-2636db15ddf14cd88ab8ecb726a70c4c and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control.

requirement.summary: Run one bounded no-model diagnostic of the reproducible user-host Codex-to-AgentGov initialize failure using read-only Windows process observation to classify the actual MCP child executable, parent chain, and only allow-listed inherited-environment facts. Do not change or wrap the launcher, inspect raw sessions or broad logs, send turn/start, repair, retry, or retain sensitive process data.

items: The failed MCP process may exit before read-only polling can capture its executable identity.
Windows process APIs may expose broad command lines or unrelated process data unless observation is filtered by the exact new Codex parent and normalized before retention.
A user-host App Server startup may update existing user-home state or attempt background network access even without a model turn.
Concurrent pre-existing Codex and AgentGov processes could be misattributed unless exact preflight identities and parent relationships are preserved.
A complete environment block may be unavailable without invasive instrumentation; unavailable facts must remain unknown.
The observed identity may suggest a repair, but this task grants no launcher modification or retry authority.
The working tree contains prior-task and user-owned excluded paths that must remain preserved.
Reviewed assumption: Transient Windows process observation can filter descendants of the exact diagnostic Codex process.
Reviewed assumption: The retained runtime and remote-free AIRBNB clone still exist and retain their recorded identities.
Reviewed assumption: The current Codex App Server can reproduce the no-turn failure through the same bounded lifecycle.
Reviewed unknown: Whether the failed MCP child persists long enough for its executable path and digest to be observed.
Reviewed unknown: Whether Codex modifies PATH or other environment values before starting the MCP child.
Reviewed unknown: Whether Windows exposes any child environment facts without a wrapper, debugger, persistent trace, or raw log.
Reviewed unknown: Whether another user-host condition besides launcher identity causes the initialize response closure.

title: Identify the failed user-host AgentGov MCP child without changing its launcher
